posts.trend: Bengaluru Metro Cost: Why Housing Access Still Falls Short
posts.context: The concept of 'co-living' or suburban rentals is sold as premium living but functions as shared density for high prices.
posts.angle: The real estate industry uses lifestyle vocabulary to mask basic housing scarcity.
slides: Your relatives are discussing your new rented flat.

"Sharing flat is okay at twenty-two."
"At thirty, she should have her own kitchen."
"Even the deposit is five months' rent."
"And she still has to take an auto to the office."
posts.caption: Send this to the person who moved to the suburbs for the 'peace' and now spends four hours in traffic.
posts.rank_verdict: The post reads as a flat transcription of gossip without finding an unexpected comedic angle or a sharp final punchline.
